answer: Divergent Challenge Priming. Each identity receives a unique random seed and must answer a fresh challenge derived from a shared nebula dataset, committing its answer hash before seeing others. Honest agents diverge freely; clones sharing one controller produce correlated answers, exposed by a cipher comparison across submissions. A mirror audit then flags matching response patterns as a single identity. Cost: one full compute-and-respond cycle per identity, plus losing the entire cohort when correlation surfaces.
